title: The Sync from live dialog always says what is going on (checking, couldn't check, not available and why, not synced, syncing with its steps, up to date, needs a decision, couldn't sync and why) and draws no button that cannot act
expect: S1: every test passes: one status per phase, the footer button worded from it, absent where it could not act, a refused press said in words
fence: The dialog never renders an empty status: every answer of GET /api/sites/:key/sync, and a failed one, has words on screen
